description: Replace all ParticleOrb usages with GeodesicOrb (SVG), remove dead SuggestionChips import from OrbShell, and clean up dead ParticleOrb files

Replace `<ParticleOrb />` usage (line 85) with `<GeodesicOrb size={168} nodes={12} spinning={25} intensity={0.7} />`. The container already has width:168 height:168.

In src/features/omicron/components/OrbShell.tsx: Remove `import ParticleOrb from './ParticleOrbLazy'` (line 4). Remove `import { SuggestionChips } from './SuggestionChips'` (line 5). Run tsc --noEmit to verify no new errors introduced (only existing react-router-dom error is acceptable).

grep -r 'ParticleOrb' /projects/sandbox/Sistema-omicrom/src/ --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts' | grep -v '.agents' || echo 'PASS: No ParticleOrb references remain'
findings: All ParticleOrb references removed successfully. tsc --noEmit passes with only the pre-existing react-router-dom error. The SuggestionChips import was on the same line group as ParticleOrb in OrbShell.tsx and was removed together.
